name: Blindfold
body:
School illusion (figment); Level sorcerer/wizard 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 full round
Components V, S, F (spirit doll marked to the target, see spirit doll enchantment spell)

EFFECT

Range long (400 ft. + 40 ft./level)
Target one creature that is marked by the spirit doll focus
Duration 1 day/level (D) (see below)
Saving Throw Will partial; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

By covering a spirit doll’s (see spirit doll enchantment) head with either hand or cloth, the target is blinded. The effect lasts as long as the doll remains covered, up to the spell’s maximum duration. If the doll is uncovered, the spell ends immediately. If the target’s save succeeds, he is not blinded but is instead dazzled (–1 to attack) for a number of rounds equal to the caster’s level.
